title: CARIAD: GID Dat Hub Tender
description:
Executive Summary

Framework agreement for development, integration, testing, data, UX, AI engineering and operations of the GIS Data Hub, planned for 36 months.
Scope is divided into 8 independently awardable work packages, allowing suppliers to bid selectively or end-to-end.
Major technology domains are Salesforce/SFCC, Adobe AEM, Microsoft Azure, E2E Testing, Data & Analytics, AI Engineering, UX/UI and Data Product Technical Leadership.
Total baseline capacity is 90,900 hours/year, with no guaranteed minimum call-off volume.
Strong focus on international rollout, cloud integration, automation, security, production operations and third-level support.
AI-assisted/agentic engineering is mandatory across all work packages, including measurable productivity and quality effects.
Delivery is primarily offsite/remote, with a Best Cost Country approach explicitly requested, making an offshore/nearshore delivery model commercially relevant.
Overall, this is a large-scale, multi-year digital platform and engineering services opportunity requiring strong enterprise delivery, DevSecOps and managed-service capabilities.
